verdict.rationale: Ramp documents built-in AI agents ("Ramp Intelligence" and four named agents) that take over finance tasks such as auto-coding, fraud flagging, approval routing, payment, receipt collection and memo drafting. These are fixed autonomous workflows, though, not an in-product assistant the user can hand arbitrary tasks to. Ramp MCP lets users delegate through external assistants like Claude and ChatGPT, but that is a host-assistant channel, not a built-in assistant, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: an in-product conversational assistant that accepts user-defined task delegation, documentation of how users instruct or scope the built-in agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
